item.title: Osaka Street Food Guide: Dotonbori and Shinsekai
item.description: Osaka Street Food Guide: Dotonbori, Shinsekai & Beyond — The Ultimate Eating Adventure Meta description: This Osaka street food guide covers Dotonbori, Shinsekai, and the city’s best street food districts — what to eat, where to find it, how to order, and when to visit for the best experience. Introduction: Why Osaka Is Japan’s Undisputed Street Food Capital There’s a reason the people of Osaka invented the word kuidaore — “to eat until you drop.
